pros.title: simple whole-fruit snack
pros.explanation: Easy to understand, easy to portion, and useful without much prep.

pros.title: skin adds colour compounds
pros.explanation: Eating the peel keeps the colourful plant-compound part of the fruit in the serving.

pros.title: works in sweet meals
pros.explanation: Plums can bring a fresh fruit role to yoghurt bowls, oats, salads, and desserts.

cons.title: bruises easily
cons.explanation: Soft fruit bruises quickly, so quality can drop fast after transport or storage.

cons.title: ripeness window is short
cons.explanation: The best eating window is narrow, and underripe or overripe plums are much less useful.

cons.title: pit slows eating down
cons.explanation: The stone makes them a little less convenient than fully edible bite-size fruit.
